title: Etudes Concertantes
identity: The ARTS² conservatory catalog records Semler-Collery’s Etudes concertantes for alto saxophone and piano ad libitum, published by Max Eschig in 1964, with ten studies and a Paris Conservatoire contest-piece designation dating to 1931. It holds a two-part edition. This source strengthens the catalog identity and pedagogical/program context.

evidence.claim: Identifies 10 studies for alto saxophone and piano ad libitum, Max Eschig, 1964; contest piece of Paris Conservatoire (1931).
Lists 2:40 duration and dedication to Marcel Mule.

review_focus: Review these as ten discrete studies rather than a single continuous sonata; check movement order, piano optionality and selected étude demands.
